children: BTIG reiterated their Buy rating on Amer Sports's stock with a price target of $42.00.
The price target implies an upside of 59.9% from the Sep 17 close of $26.27.
Key takeaways from the analyst note

: Amer Sports is expected to achieve a compound annual growth rate (CAGR) in revenue of low double-digits to mid-teens percentage through 2031, driven by significant growth in key markets like North America and China, as well as strategic investments in direct-to-consumer (DTC) channels.

: The company is forecasted to expand its adjusted operating margins by 30-70 basis points annually, supported by a favorable mix shift towards higher-margin products and continued investments in brand development, positioning it well for long-term profitability.
